_comment: RTT1B arrival into LOWI runway 08 (RNAV Z 08). Chosen because it drives the OTHER vectoring mechanism: the STAR ends at ELMEM, west of the field, and the approach transition turns straight back east to the IAF WI749 -- a ~180 degree reversal, which is what poll_vector_to_intercept exists for. The pattern mechanism (poll_vector_to_final) must stay OUT of it. Arrival from the east via NANIT and RTT, so the aircraft flies past Innsbruck westbound and comes back on the approach. [C. P. Potter]
